findings.title: Shortcut hotstring auto-close is admitted but never closes its Linux page
findings.reproduction: Open the hotstring editor through its shortcut, enable auto_close, add one entry and save without the Add another option. Shared script.js:1290-1293 posts close after persist. Alternatively route that exact {action:'close',data:{}} from a current hsEditor page. Replay probes/editor.lua SOURCE_ROOT: CLOSE_RECEIPT close_calls=0 reply=nil despite an accepting exact close_owned_window capability. This is a bridge/native-port model, not live GTK measurement.
findings.root_cause: linux/ui/hotstring_editor/bridge.lua:694-697 recognizes close but only logs 'closed' and returns nil; it never calls the manager-supplied epoch-owned context.close_owned_window. Therefore the registered route cannot reach native hide/destroy or input ownership release for this admitted command.
findings.silent_failure: The handler logs that the editor closed even though no close was requested. Existing opening-source tests verify saves, while native lifecycle tests verify hide once invoked; neither joins the shared auto-close command to this handler.
findings.regression_test: Use the actual manager and bridge with faithful GTK ports. Open shortcut mode with auto_close, deliver the shared page's close command, require exactly one close of the current page, physical retirement acknowledgements and input release. Refused native retirement must retain debt and report refusal; stale close must not retire a successor. Healthy manual window close is the control. Coordinate the shared save acknowledgment with MVB-002: successful save may auto-close, but refused save must preserve the draft when the current Linux no-op is fixed.
findings.other_os: macOS ui/hotstring_editor/init.lua handle_message close calls M.close. Windows has a distinct personal-TOML editor, so the same API is not owed; its exact corresponding shortcut close join is outside this Linux proof. The separate shared page's premature close before save acknowledgement is coordinated with the macOS reviewer.

basis.kind: actual production Lua owners over explicit native-port fixtures, plus stated Linux native controls
basis.native_limits: Linux host only. Windows AHK/WebView2 and Darwin Hammerspoon/WebKit/launchd/System Extensions receiving boundaries were not executed. See scope report for exact synthetic input and source-only joins.
